description: This file defines the UnseekableStreamException class within the Laminas\Diactoros\Exception namespace, representing specific exception cases when dealing with stream seeking errors.

classes.name: UnseekableStreamException
classes.description: An exception class indicating errors related to non-seekable streams, providing static factory methods for different error scenarios.

methods.name: dueToConfiguration
methods.description: Creates an instance of UnseekableStreamException indicating the stream is not seekable due to configuration issues.

methods.name: dueToMissingResource
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating that no resource is available for seeking within the stream.

methods.name: dueToPhpError
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating an error occurred within PHP while attempting to seek within a stream.

methods.name: forCallbackStream
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating that callback streams cannot seek position.
